Create a paywall or onboarding flow, empty or starting as a template's design ('voidhash paywall
template list'). It is designed in the dashboard, and nobody sees it until it is deployed and a
location shows it.

Usage:
  voidhash paywall create [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help                       Show help for this command
      --json                       Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --kind <paywall|onboarding>  A paywall (the default, or the template's purpose), or
                                   onboarding, a flow of screens
      --name <name>                What people see, such as Summer sale
      --project <project>          Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                   (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                      Print only ids, one per line
      --slug <slug>                How analytics name it (default: made from the name); it cannot
                                   change later
      --template <template>        A template whose design it starts as, such as plan-picker;
                                   'voidhash paywall template list' lists them

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash paywall create --name "Summer sale"
  voidhash paywall create --name "Summer sale" --template plan-picker
  voidhash paywall create --name Welcome --slug welcome --kind onboarding
